<h2>Run Ordered Conditional Likelihood Calls with Progress</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Preserves sjSDM's iteration order and simplification while reporting each
taxon's start, completion, and elapsed time without drawing random numbers.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_likelihood_sequence(
  X,
  FUN,
  ...,
  simplify = TRUE,
  USE.NAMES = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  progress_state = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="X">X</code></td>
<td>
<p>Ordered indices supplied by sjSDM's conditional likelihood helper.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="FUN">FUN</code></td>
<td>
<p>Per-taxon likelihood function supplied by sjSDM.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="...">...</code></td>
<td>
<p>Additional arguments forwarded unchanged to FUN.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="simplify">simplify</code>, <code id="USE.NAMES">USE.NAMES</code></td>
<td>
<p>Simplification controls from the upstream call.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="verbose">verbose</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical; print timestamped likelihood progress.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="progress_state">progress_state</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional private environment tracking ANOVA pass names.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>An array or list with the same values as the upstream mapping.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>run_sjsdm_likelihood_sequence(
  X = 1:3,
  FUN = base::identity,
  verbose = FALSE
)
</code></pre>

</main>
